title: A Choir for the Ember
author: Xanthe Eastwick
blurb: Astrid Eriksen, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
